claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_feature.on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sneak Attack is a passive class feature whose core mechanic is an on-hit rider, but class_feature only supports the activation family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll

claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_feature.on_hit_trigger.qualifying_predicates
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface needs to express Sneak Attack's eligibility gates: finesse or ranged weapon, advantage OR nearby non-incapacitated ally, and no disadvantage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or a Ranged weapon. You don't need Advantage ... if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target, the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, and you don't have Disadvantage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_type_from_weapon_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing damage surfaces require a fixed damage type, but Sneak Attack inherits the damage type from the qualifying weapon hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage's type is the same as the weapon's type.
